Fiend's Mouth Cannon.name: 鬼頭火炮（Fiend's Mouth Cannon）
Fiend's Mouth Cannon.description:
班組 3; 瞄準 1; 裝填 3; 速度 0尺

  此類重型火炮通常由多塊金屬分別鑄成部件後組裝，有時會將炮口塑成惡魔、魔鬼或其他妖怪的大嘴形狀。與加農火炮類似，它們以巨大推進力直接噴射彈藥。鬼頭火炮的啞火範圍為1（炸膛半徑30尺）；硬度為10，生命值為140。鬼頭火炮的每顆彈丸重30磅，價格為45gp。

Fighting Fan.name: 鐵骨扇（Fighting fan）
Fighting Fan.description: 雖然從外表上看起來與普通的綢面或紙摺扇無異，鐵骨扇的扇骨乃是用精鋼所鑄。鐵骨扇通常成對使用以更好的在戰鬥中擾亂對手，它的扇骨通常會修出尖頭並可能喂毒。

Fire Lance.name: 突火矛（Fire Lance）
Fire Lance.description:
啞火 1-4 (5尺); 彈容量 1

  這種原始的火器就只是一根長管，點燃後會從閘門射出火焰和標槍。和其他火器不同，飛火矛非常不精準，攻擊目標的AC而非接觸AC。飛火矛的啞火效果總是視為破損。飛火矛的彈藥為1支標槍和2份黑火藥。這是一件早期火器。

Firearm Bullet (1).name: 火器彈頭（Firearm Bullet (1)）
Firearm Bullet (1).description: 大部分單手和雙手火器的彈藥。彈頭的典型形態是一個小鉛球，或其它金屬。

Firearm Bullet (30).name: 火器彈頭（Firearm Bullet (30)）
Firearm Bullet (30).description: 大部分單手和雙手火器的彈藥。彈頭的典型形態是一個小鉛球，或其它金屬。

Firedrake.name: 炎蛟炮（Firedrake）
Firedrake.description:
班組 3; 瞄準 2; 裝填 5; 速度 10尺

  此類大型攻城兵器通常裝有輪子、或裝載於載具上，以便於運送到戰場。該裝置能在60尺線形或30尺錐形區域內噴射大團烈焰（由機師長決定）。區域內生物受到6d6火焰傷害（通過DC為15的反射豁免後減半）；豁免失敗的生物還將著火。破損狀態下的炎蛟炮一旦再次掉鏈便會爆炸，對20尺爆發半徑內的所有生物造成同等傷害（通過DC為15的反射豁免後減半）。炎蛟炮的硬度為10，生命值為70。炎蛟炮每次發射所需的彈藥重20磅，價格為200gp。

Firewyrm.name: 炎龍炮（Firewyrm）
Firewyrm.description:
班組 5; 瞄準 2; 裝填 6; 速度 0尺

  此攻城兵器是炎蛟炮的放大版。炎龍炮過於巨大以至於無法完整地運送到戰場，只能在部件被運送到戰場後就地安裝。炎龍炮能在120尺線形或60尺錐形區域內噴射大團烈焰（由機師長決定）。區域內生物受到6d6火焰傷害（通過DC為20的反射豁免後減半）；豁免失敗的生物還將著火。破損狀態下的炎龍炮一旦再次掉鏈便會爆炸，對30尺爆發半徑內的所有生物造成同等傷害（通過DC為20的反射豁免後減半）。炎龍炮的硬度為10，生命值為140。炎龍炮每次發射所需的彈藥重40磅，價格為400gp。

Flak.name: Flak（Flak）
Flak.description:
Source Dragonslayer's Handbook pg. 27

Statistics

Cost 500 gp Weight 30 lbs.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

Description

Flak ammunition is a type of short-fused bomb, specifically designed to explode in midair. Flak ammunition is packed with steel balls and black powder, and may be fired from a bombard or catapult. When flak explodes, it deals 4d6 points of piercing and bludgeoning damage to all creatures and objects within 40 feet of the target square. A flak bomb must reach an altitude of at least 50 feet to function properly. If flak ammunition impacts anything before it reaches this altitude, the bomb deals 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage and fails to explode.

Flambard.name: Flambard（Flambard）
Flambard.description:
This two-handed sword has a wavy blade that is especially useful for cutting through wooden weapons.

  If you are proficient with this weapon, you gain a +4 bonus on any sunder attempts made against weapons with a wooden haft; otherwise you may use this sword as a bastard sword.

Flask Pike.name: Flask Pike（Flask Pike）
Flask Pike.description:
Source Giant Hunter's Handbook pg. 24

Statistics

Cost 30 gp Weight 9 lbs.

Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x3; Range -; Type P; Special reach, see text

Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Exotic

Description

This pike has a hollow spot near its tip into which a flask can be strapped. If the flask is filled with an alchemical splash weapon and you hit a creature with the pike, the target is also hit with the splash weapon. This uses up the contents of the flask. Because of the added weight of a flask, attacks with the flask pike take a -2 penalty when it's loaded with one. Reloading the flask pike is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Flechette Bolt.name: Flechette Bolt（Flechette Bolt）
Flechette Bolt.description:
Source Dragonslayer's Handbook pg. 27

Statistics

Cost 30 gp Weight 20 lbs.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

Description

This ballista bolt consists of dozens of small steel darts, called flechettes, which break away after the bolt is released. If the bolt impacts anything before it reaches a distance of 30 feet, it deals 1d8 points of damage. Between 30 and 60 feet away, the flechettes deploy, dealing piercing damage to every creature and object within a 30-foot-cone burst. After 60 feet, the flechettes lose momentum and fall harmlessly to the ground.

Separate attack rolls must be made against each target hit by the burst. Light ballista flechettes deal 2d8 points of damage, while heavy ballista flechettes deal 3d8 points. Additionally, any winged creature hit by flechettes has several holes punched in its wings, and has its fly speed reduced by 10 feet. The creature takes a -4 penalty on Fly checks until the damage is healed.

Flickmace.name: Flickmace（Flickmace）
Flickmace.description: The innovation behind a flick-mace, which has an ordinary mace head, lies within its spring-loaded haft and protruding handles. When the mace is compressed, removing the handles instantly springs the mace to its full size. While it is extended, a quick flick of the wrist allows the weapon to be compressed.

Flight Arrows (20).name: 飛箭（Flight Arrows (20)）
Flight Arrows (20).description: 這種箭矢的輕杆提供了極遠的射程。長弓使用飛箭時的射程增量提高20尺，短弓則提高10尺。它們判斷傷害時視為武器型號小於實際一級。

Flindbar.name: Flindbar（Flindbar）
Flindbar.description: This one-handed weapon is similar to a nunchaku in that it consists of a pair of bars linked with heavy chain. However, a flindbar’s bars are made of iron and are capped with a ring of spikes or studs. Since it’s much heaver than a nunchaku, it is not a light weapon.

Gargantuan Gallery.name: 巨型廊車（Gargantuan Gallery）
Gargantuan Gallery.description:
班組 9; 速度 15尺

  廊車是形如革制或木造建築般的可移動防禦工事。多數廊車結構脆弱，但亦偶有較為堅固的實例（採用攻城兵器的裝甲規則，並調整其AC、硬度和生命值等資料）。廊車基本上由可移動的“牆壁”部分，加上作為“屋頂”的另一塊部件構成（內建破城槌的廊車是個例外，通常由兩塊接合的外壁部分和頂蓋部分構成）。由於廊車是局部開放結構，因此無法像正常的建築般提供掩護：若廊車內的生物體型與廊車相同則獲得掩蔽，小於廊車一級則獲得強化掩蔽，小於廊車兩級以上則視為全掩蔽。廊車的體型空間類似生物——一輛大型廊車能夠容納和保護的生物數量如同大型生物，等等。

  【譯註：即大型廊車能容納1個大型生物或4箇中型生物；可參考怪物通用規則的活吞能力。】

  裝有輪子的木造廊車可以在由完整機師組操作時以10尺的速度移動，或在機師組減半的情況下移動5尺。廊車的基本速度為15尺（在安裝中甲或重甲時為10尺）。廊車的硬度為5，生命值基於其體型。大型、超大型、巨型和超巨型廊車的生命值分別為30點、120點、320點和625點。

Gargantuan Ram.name: 巨型破城槌（Gargantuan Ram）
Gargantuan Ram.description:
班組 20; 速度 15尺

  這種包有金屬頭箍的圓木當屬最基本的突擊型兵器，由一個或多個生物合力使用。破城槌可用於對目標造成傷害，或針對目標的破壞DC進行力量檢定。

  破城槌衝鋒（Ramming Charge）：破城槌的有效使用需要蓄積動量。使用破城槌的所有生物必須通過沖鋒動作來使其發揮最大效用。不願衝鋒的生物可以通過一個整輪動作來進行破城槌攻擊，攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定都受到-4減值。

  破壞 / 擊破（Breaking）：機師長進行一次有+2加值的力量檢定，協助攻擊的每位機師組成員都會額外給予+2加值（體型更大的生物則等效換算）。破城槌本身的體型每大於中型一級，會再給予該檢定+4加值。

  傷害（Damage）：機師長進行一次受-4不擅長減值的攻擊檢定，命中則造成列表中給出的傷害值，外加機師長和全體機師組成員的力量修正，體型不會影響該修正。

  臨時破城槌（Improvised Ram）：任何樹木、圓木或木料都可以當作破城槌使用，但攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定都受到-4減值。

  鎬頭（Pick）：擁有鎬頭的破城槌在對抗石造建築時，攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定獲得+2環境加值。

  鑽頭（Screw）：擁有鑽頭的破城槌在對抗土造建築時，攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定獲得+2環境加值。

  廊車破城槌（Gallery Ram）：該破城槌被鐵鏈或繩索懸吊在廊車內部。廊車破城槌無需衝鋒來獲得最大動量。此外，在尾部加裝引繩可使能夠協助使用該破城槌的機師組成員額外增加4人。

  生命值（Hit Points）：破城槌硬度為5，生命值基於體型。大型、超大型、巨型和超巨型破城槌的生命值分別為30點、120點、320點和625點。

Gargantuan Siege Tower.name: 巨型攻城塔（Gargantuan Siege Tower）
Gargantuan Siege Tower.description:
班組 24; 速度 15尺

  這是一臺具有堅固結構的木造廊車——攻城塔擁有高大的護頂部件。木塔的下部內含了推動該攻城塔的機師組成員，併為他們提供全掩蔽效果。破損狀態的攻城塔只能以半速移動。若攻城塔被破壞，整座木塔將崩毀。此種情況將視為坍塌來處理。攻城塔的上部為一定數量（見下文）的士兵提供強化掩蔽效果，並擁有可供遠程武器攻擊的射擊孔。塔頂部分可以加裝垛牆、並安置一臺體型不大於該攻城塔的攻城兵器，外加一副鐵鴉喙。攻城塔的基本速度為15尺（在安裝中甲或重甲時為10尺）。攻城塔硬度為5，生命值基於體型。大型、超大型、巨型和超巨型攻城塔的生命值分別為60點、240點、640點和1250點。

Garrote.name: Garrote（Garrote）
Garrote.description:
In order to use a garrote, your opponent must be helpless or unaware of you. You must make a grapple check (though you avoid the –4 penalty for not having two hands free) to successfully begin garroting your opponent. Sneak attack damage does not apply to a garrote. Your garroted opponent must make a concentration check (DC 20 + your CMB + level of the spell he’s casting) to cast a spell with a verbal component, use a command word item, or use any magic requiring speech. You gain the following additional option when grappling with a garrote.

  Choke: You cut off your target’s air supply so he has to hold his breath (see Suffocation, and the Swim skill for additional information). Any round you do not maintain the choke, your opponent can take a breath and restart when he has to begin making Constitution checks.

Gas Cylinder.name: 毒氣罐（Gas Cylinder）
Gas Cylinder.description:
這具大型金屬罐可以用來施放毒性氣體攻擊，將它開啟後置於敵方陣地的下風處，毒氣雲團就會自動填滿整個區域以造成傷害。同時開啟多個排列成線型的毒氣罐可以迅速製造出覆蓋整個戰場的毒雲。如果要使用毒氣罐，首先骰1d4決定風向（1：北風；2：東風；3：南風；4：西風）一旦開啟，毒氣罐就會開始向15尺半徑的錐形區域釋放芥子氣雲（見邊欄）。兩輪後雲團會再延伸15尺，在第三輪形成寬15尺，長45尺的毒霧。隨著風力的推動，毒雲也會同時開始運動，強風（21英里/小時）可以在4輪內將毒雲完全吹散，烈風（31英里/小時）則只需要1輪。

在世界大戰中投入軍用的芥子氣（以及同時代的氯氣和光氣）至少造成了90000人痛苦而殘酷的死亡，以及至少百萬人永久性致殘。

芥子氣可以通過毒氣罐和毒氣手榴彈投放，在視覺效果上，芥子氣毒雲的效果等同於隱霧術，不過毒霧的顏色是黃綠色的。

任何接觸芥子氣毒霧的活物都會受到3d6點強酸傷害，在首次與毒霧接觸時，生物還必須通過一個DC18的強韌檢定，否則只要逗留在毒霧的範圍內它就會一直處於反胃和目盲的狀態，即使在離開毒霧範圍後，該效果也會持續1d4+1輪。如果生物成功通過此檢定但仍然留在毒霧範圍內，它依然每輪都要重新進行強韌檢定，這是一個毒素效果。因為芥子氣的重量大於空氣，在被釋放到空氣中後芥子氣會很快沉降到地面，所以芥子氣對於塹壕和坑道極其有效。裝備有防毒面具（見下文）的角色免疫芥子氣的效果，不過屏息並不能免疫芥子氣。

Gastraphetes.name: Gastraphetes（Gastraphetes）
Gastraphetes.description:
Source Distant Shores pg. 12

Statistics

Cost 65 gp Weight 12 lbs.

Damage 1d10 (small), 1d12 (medium); Critical 19-20/x2; Range 120 ft.; Type P; Special -

Category Ranged; Proficiency Martial

Description

The gastraphetes, sometimes called a "belly bow," is an oversized crossbow reloaded by pressing one end against the ground, the other against one's abdomen, and locking the string in place through ratchet action. Reloading takes a full-round action, uses two hands, and requires that the wielder be standing. Wielding a gastraphetes requires two hands, and due to the weapon's bulk, firing it while standing without support (such as a wall, a window, or a stand) imposes a -4 penalty on attack rolls; you take no penalty for firing a gastraphetes while prone. A Large or larger creature can use a gastraphetes one size smaller than itself without any support, but takes the normal penalty for firing an inappropriately sized weapon.

Gate Breaker Ballista.name: 破城型弩炮（Gate Breaker Ballista）
Gate Breaker Ballista.description:
班組 5; 瞄準 3; 裝填 5; 速度 0尺

  形如一把巨大的十字弓弩，弩車通過一對可調整的轉軸來為絞線積蓄彈力。轉軸之間的絞線被向後拉，即可在滑槽中裝填用以發射的彈藥。弩炮是一種直射型兵器。

  這種巨大的弩炮發射特殊的鈍頭方形箭。它們被當作遠程戰錘，轟向城堡的圍牆或城門。當擊中木製建築物時，重擊範圍為19-20/×3。破城型弩炮硬度為5，生命值為200。破城弩炮的弩矢每支重30磅，價格為50gp。

Gnome Flick-Mace.name: Gnome Flick-Mace（Gnome Flick-Mace）
Gnome Flick-Mace.description:
Source Gnomes of Golarion pg. 22

Statistics

Cost 20 gp Weight 10 lbs.

Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x2; Range -; Type B; Special reach, trip

Category One-Handed; Proficiency Exotic

Description

The description for this item was cut from Gnomes of Golarion. - Nethys

Grappling Hook.name: Grappling Hook（Grappling Hook）
Grappling Hook.description:
Source Pirates of the Inner Sea pg. 19, Skull and Shackles Player's Guide pg. 6

Statistics

Cost 6 gp Weight 14 lbs.

Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x2; Range 10 ft.; Type P; Special grappling

Category Ranged; Proficiency Exotic

Description

A grappling hook is usually thought of as a climbing instrument, but is also used to grapple enemy ships and draw them close before a boarding action.

Grappling hooks bite deeply into the wood of the railing. It takes 1 minute to pry a grappling hook free. The rope attached to a grappling hook can be cut, but pirates often target the rigging and masts to make it difficult to remove the hooks. Tying off the rope of a grappling hook is a move action.

A grappling hook can also be used as a ranged weapon. If you are proficient in the grappling hook, it is a grappling weapon. On a successful critical hit with a weapon of this type, you can grapple the target of the attack. You can attempt a combat maneuver check to grapple your opponent as a free action. This grapple attempt does not provoke an attack of opportunity from the creature you are attempting to grapple if that creature is not threatening you. While you grapple the target with a grappling weapon, you can only move or damage the creature on your turn. You are still considered grappled, though you do not have to be adjacent to the creature to continue the grapple. If you move far enough away to be out of the weapon's reach, the grapple ends.

A grappling hook's weight includes the weight of 50 feet of hemp rope. It can be reduced by using shorter or lighter rope.

Great Terbutje.name: 石刃大劍（Great terbutje）
Great Terbutje.description: 這件石器時代的武器是石刃劍的放大版。過於巨大使得它難以在經受特殊訓練之前單手使用；因此這是一件異種武器。你能在雙手持用石刃大劍的情況下將其視為軍用武器。

Greatclub.name: 巨木棒（Greatclub）
Greatclub.description: 這把普通木棒的巨大笨重版沉到你無法單手持用的地步。它可能經過了裝飾和雕刻、以金屬強化過，也有可能僅是個大樹枝。巨木棒和尋常木棒一樣有很多名字，譬如大棒、巨棒、棒棒等。

Groaning Bullets (10).name: Groaning Bullets (10)（Groaning Bullets (10)）
Groaning Bullets (10).description:
Source Adventurer's Armory pg. 3

Statistics

Cost 2 gp Weight 5 lbs.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

Description

These sling bullets are honeycombed with overlapping perforations that cause them to emit an eerie moan audible within 500 feet of their flight path.

Gunsmith's Kit.name: 炮匠工具（Gunsmith's Kit）
Gunsmith's Kit.description: 這種小工具套有用來製造、維修和儲存一件火器所需的所有工具，除了必須的原料。沒有炮匠工具，你將無法正常地製造或保養火器。

Halfling Double Sling.name: Halfling Double Sling（Halfling Double Sling）
Halfling Double Sling.description:
Source Halflings of Golarion pg. 22

Statistics

Cost 10 gp Weight 1 lb.

Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical x2; Range 50 ft.; Type B; Special double (see text)

Category Ranged; Proficiency Exotic

Description

At first glance resembling a baton-like stick with a sling dangling from each end, this weapon requires extraordinary skill, or halfling acrobatics, to use to full effect. You can use a double sling as a normal sling, or use the second end to make one additional ranged attack each round. You take the normal penalties for fighting with two weapons when you use both ends of a double sling (as if it were a double weapon); the Two- Weapon Fighting feat reduces these penalties as normal. Reloading one end of a double sling is a move action ( just like a normal sling), so unless you have an ability or feat (such as Ammo Drop) that allows you to quickly reload a sling, you cannot normally make multiple attacks per round for several consecutive rounds with this weapon.

You can hurl ordinary stones with a double sling, but stones are not as dense or as round as bullets. Thus, such an attack deals damage as if the weapon were designed for a creature one size category smaller than you, and you take a -1 penalty on attack rolls.

Halfling Stitched Sling.name: Halfling Stitched Sling（Halfling Stitched Sling）
Halfling Stitched Sling.description:
Source Halflings of Golarion pg. 22

Statistics

Cost - Weight 1 lb.

Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x2; Range -; Type B; Special disarm, trip

Category Ranged; Proficiency Exotic

Description

Technically not a unique kind of weapon, a stitched sling is a sling, staff sling, or double sling whose cup is sewn closed around the ammunition, creating a weak sort of light flail. The ammunition sewn into the sling is irrelevant to the type and amount of damage it causes. A stitched sling cannot be used to fire ammunition unless the thread or cord holding the cup closed is cut open (a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity).

Hanbo.name: Hanbo（Hanbo）
Hanbo.description:
Source Adventurer's Armory pg. 3

Statistics

Cost 1 gp Weight 2 lbs.

Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x2; Range -; Type B; Special monk, trip

Category Light; Proficiency Simple

Weapon Groups Monk

Description

The hanbo is a staff less than a yard long, often carved to look like a walking stick.

Handwraps.name: Handwraps（Handwraps）
Handwraps.description:
Many unarmed fighters wrap their hands in cloth to minimize injuries to their fists.

  Some martial artists also weave small coins or metal bars into their handwraps, adding special material effects as well. Handwraps don’t alter the damage a character’s unarmed attacks deal. However, masterwork handwraps can be enchanted as weapons, providing their benefits on unarmed attacks the character makes with her hands. A character can’t benefit from both handwraps and other items that provide enhancement bonuses or weapon special abilities (such as an amulet of mighty fists) on the same attack.

Harvester.name: Harvester（Harvester）
Harvester.description:
Source Belkzen, Hold of the Orc Hordes pg. 39

Statistics

Cost 800 gp Weight -

Damage 2d8; Critical x4; Range -; Type S

Crew 4; Aim 0; Load 0; Speed 0 ft.

Category Close Assault; Proficiency Siege Engine

Description

A variety of scythe-like blades extend from two sides of this wheeled machine. When it's pulled-typically by an aurochs or enslaved giants-the wheels' rotation causes the blades to slash indiscriminately. Each round the harvester moves, it makes a melee attack with a +10 modifier against any adjacent creature it passes; it deals 2d8 points of damage to those it hits. Multiple harvesters can be strung together. The crew required for a train of harvesters is equal to the total crew of the individual machines. Adjacent creatures are attacked by each individual harvester that passes them. A harvester has a hardness of 5 and 50 hit points.

A harvester is a Large siege engine.

Heartstake Bolts (5).name: Heartstake Bolts (5)（Heartstake Bolts (5)）
Heartstake Bolts (5).description:
Source Advanced Race Guide pg. 99

Statistics

Cost 100 gp Weight 3 lbs.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

Description

Specially crafted from solid darkwood, heartstake bolts are specifically designed to slay vampires. A heartstake bolt can be fired from any crossbow, but it imposes a -2 penalty on the attack roll and halves the range increment of the weapon. A vampire struck with a heartstake bolt takes the normal damage but must also succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude saving throw or fall to the ground helpless for 1 round.

While the vampire is helpless in this manner, a creature can attempt to use the heartstake bolt to finish off the vampire by driving it through the vampire's heart as a full-round action. Once the debilitating effect of the heartstake bolt has ended, the vampire can pull out the bolt as a move action. A vampire slain with a heartstake bolt is subject to the rules and limitations of slaying a vampire with a wooden stake as described under vampire weaknesses .

 

A heartstake bolt deals normal damage for the crossbow of its type.

Heavy Ballista.name: 重型弩炮（Heavy Ballista）
Heavy Ballista.description:
班組 3; 瞄準 2; 裝填 3; 速度 0尺

  形如一把巨大的十字弓弩，弩車通過一對可調整的轉軸來為絞線積蓄彈力。轉軸之間的絞線被向後拉，即可在滑槽中裝填用以發射的彈藥。弩炮是一種直射型兵器。

  這種超大型弩炮常被用於城防，或被架設在戰艦上。重型弩炮硬度為5，生命值為100。重型弩炮的弩矢每支重20磅，價格為30gp。

Heavy Bombard.name: 重型臼炮（Heavy Bombard）
Heavy Bombard.description:
班組 4; 瞄準 3; 裝填 5; 速度 0尺

  形如一口大釜、或者其他傳統火炮，此類火器讓彈藥劃過高挑的弧線，給軍陣或城牆造成致命打擊。臼炮通常用於拋射，但也能作為直射型兵器射擊。當用於直射時，攻擊檢定承受-4減值、同時射程增量減半，但不再具有最小射程的限制。與所有火器類似，臼炮不會掉鏈但有其啞火率。

  這種巨大的攻城兵器一般被固定於山頂或要塞頂部，用死亡之雨洗禮一片山谷或海峽。巨型臼炮常由螺絲裝置連結的兩部分組成。裝填彈藥時旋開該裝置，然後再將炮身的主要部分旋迴並與炮管相連，進行擊發。巨型臼炮過於巨大和強力，以至於無法安裝在載具上。重型臼炮的彈道檢定DC為25，啞火範圍為1-2（炸膛半徑30尺）；硬度為10，生命值為280。重型臼炮的每顆彈丸重50磅，價格為45gp。

Heavy Catapult.name: 重型投石車（Heavy Catapult）
Heavy Catapult.description:
班組 4; 瞄準 3; 裝填 3; 速度 0尺

  投石車是通過旋轉鉸線把手來扭轉投臂蓄力、再將置於投臂末端杯槽內的重物拋射出去的投石型攻城兵器。投石車可以擊發一系列不同類型的彈藥（上表中給出的傷害值預設為投射石塊；其他投射物可在下文中找到）。它們屬於拋射型兵器。

  此類巨型攻城兵器過於巨大，以至於無法完整地運送到戰場，只能就地安裝。重型投石車的彈道檢定DC為25；硬度為5，生命值為200。重型投石車的每顆投石重90磅，價格為25gp。

Heavy Shield.name: 重型盾牌（Heavy shield）
Heavy Shield.description: 除了防禦，你還能用重型盾牌猛砸敵人。

Heavy Slaver's Crossbow.name: Heavy Slaver's Crossbow（Heavy Slaver's Crossbow）
Heavy Slaver's Crossbow.description:
Source Monster Codex pg. 45

Statistics

Cost 400 gp Weight 12 lbs.

Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical 19-20/see "bolas bolts" text; Range 80 ft.; Type B; Special nonlethal, trip, see text

Category Ranged; Proficiency Exotic

Description

This crossbow shoots ammunition called bolas bolts instead of crossbow bolts. It comes in both light and heavy varieties (but not double, hand, or repeating crossbow varieties) with the same reload action as a conventional crossbow of its type.

Heavy Trebuchet.name: 重型拋石機（Heavy Trebuchet）
Heavy Trebuchet.description:
班組 4; 瞄準 3; 裝填 3; 速度 0尺

  拋石機與投石車相似，將重物置於長臂末端的籃筐內，再用配重（通常由人力或畜力拉緊繩索來代替）控制槓桿另一端。拋石機通過槓桿原理可拋出足以同時攻擊數個方格的大量物體，攻擊區域大小取決於拋石機自身體型。拋石機過於笨重，以至於無法以車輪或載具驅動，只能在戰場上進行組裝。拋石機的最小射程為150尺。

  該巨型攻城兵器通常向目標拋射巨石（彈道檢定DC為25）。重型拋石機的散射彈藥對目標方格造成完整傷害，並對該目標方格30尺範圍內所有生物和物體造成一半傷害（生物可以進行DC為25的反射豁免來將傷害減半）。輕型拋石機的硬度為5，生命值為200。重型拋石機每次拋射所用的巨石重120磅，價格為30gp。

Heavy Wrist Launcher.name: Heavy Wrist Launcher（Heavy Wrist Launcher）
Heavy Wrist Launcher.description: A larger version of the wrist launcher, this device fires a single crossbow bolt instead of a featherweight dart. If you are proficient with hand crossbows, you are also proficient with heavy wrist launchers.

Hook Hand.name: Hook Hand（Hook Hand）
Hook Hand.description:
Pirates who lose a hand in the course of their adventures sometimes attach hooks to their wrists.

  Your opponent cannot use a disarm action to disarm you of a hook hand. Hook hands generally do not interfere with routine activities, but you cannot use another weapon two-handed if you have a hook hand attached. You cannot use any type of weapon if both your hands are hook hands, and you may have trouble with routine activities.

  Hook hands presume that the wrist joint is intact. If the wrist joint is not intact, use the prosthesis statistics instead. It takes 1 minute to attach or detach a hook hand.

Hooked Lance.name: 鉤鐮槍（Hooked lance）
Hooked Lance.description: 這種纖細，約有10尺長度的長槍在槍頭上還裝有一個突出的倒鉤，可以用來在戰鬥中鉤掛對手的衣甲。

Horse Bow.name: Horse Bow（Horse Bow）
Horse Bow.description:
Source Merchant's Manifest pg. 24

Statistics

Cost 150 gp Weight 3 lbs.

Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x3; Range 110 ft.; Type P; Special -

Category Ranged; Proficiency Exotic

Description

The horse bow functions like a composite longbow, but it is designed to be used on horseback. A rider using a horse bow can make ranged attacks while mounted; furthermore, she does not take a penalty to attack rolls when her mount is taking a double move action, and she takes only a -4 penalty on attack rolls when her mount is running. The price of this item is for a default horse bow; each point of Strength bonus granted by the horse bow adds 150 gp to its cost.

Hotchkiss 6 Pounder.name: 哈齊開斯6磅速射炮（Hotchkiss 6 Pounder）
Hotchkiss 6 Pounder.description:
啞火 1; 彈容量 1

  班組 2; 瞄準 0; 裝填 2;

  哈齊開斯6磅速射炮是哈齊開斯6磅海軍炮改造後發放給陸軍使用的短身管版本，它也是第一次世界大戰期間早期的Mark IV型坦克所使用的坦克炮。哈齊開斯6磅速射炮是一件直射型先進攻城兵器，它必須架設或是搭載於裝甲車輛上使用。哈齊開斯6磅速射炮使用的高爆炮彈可以對落點周圍半徑30尺內的所有生物造成8d6點鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害（通過DC20的反射檢定減半）。哈齊開斯6磅速射炮是一件中型武器，具有10點硬度和70點生命值，每發哈齊開斯炮彈重6磅，價值25GP。

Huge Gallery.name: 超大型廊車（Huge Gallery）
Huge Gallery.description:
班組 6; 速度 15尺

  廊車是形如革制或木造建築般的可移動防禦工事。多數廊車結構脆弱，但亦偶有較為堅固的實例（採用攻城兵器的裝甲規則，並調整其AC、硬度和生命值等資料）。廊車基本上由可移動的“牆壁”部分，加上作為“屋頂”的另一塊部件構成（內建破城槌的廊車是個例外，通常由兩塊接合的外壁部分和頂蓋部分構成）。由於廊車是局部開放結構，因此無法像正常的建築般提供掩護：若廊車內的生物體型與廊車相同則獲得掩蔽，小於廊車一級則獲得強化掩蔽，小於廊車兩級以上則視為全掩蔽。廊車的體型空間類似生物——一輛大型廊車能夠容納和保護的生物數量如同大型生物，等等。

  【譯註：即大型廊車能容納1個大型生物或4箇中型生物；可參考怪物通用規則的活吞能力。】

  裝有輪子的木造廊車可以在由完整機師組操作時以10尺的速度移動，或在機師組減半的情況下移動5尺。廊車的基本速度為15尺（在安裝中甲或重甲時為10尺）。廊車的硬度為5，生命值基於其體型。大型、超大型、巨型和超巨型廊車的生命值分別為30點、120點、320點和625點。

Huge Ram.name: 超大型破城槌（Huge Ram）
Huge Ram.description:
班組 10; 速度 15尺

  這種包有金屬頭箍的圓木當屬最基本的突擊型兵器，由一個或多個生物合力使用。破城槌可用於對目標造成傷害，或針對目標的破壞DC進行力量檢定。

  破城槌衝鋒（Ramming Charge）：破城槌的有效使用需要蓄積動量。使用破城槌的所有生物必須通過沖鋒動作來使其發揮最大效用。不願衝鋒的生物可以通過一個整輪動作來進行破城槌攻擊，攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定都受到-4減值。

  破壞 / 擊破（Breaking）：機師長進行一次有+2加值的力量檢定，協助攻擊的每位機師組成員都會額外給予+2加值（體型更大的生物則等效換算）。破城槌本身的體型每大於中型一級，會再給予該檢定+4加值。

  傷害（Damage）：機師長進行一次受-4不擅長減值的攻擊檢定，命中則造成列表中給出的傷害值，外加機師長和全體機師組成員的力量修正，體型不會影響該修正。

  臨時破城槌（Improvised Ram）：任何樹木、圓木或木料都可以當作破城槌使用，但攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定都受到-4減值。

  鎬頭（Pick）：擁有鎬頭的破城槌在對抗石造建築時，攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定獲得+2環境加值。

  鑽頭（Screw）：擁有鑽頭的破城槌在對抗土造建築時，攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定獲得+2環境加值。

  廊車破城槌（Gallery Ram）：該破城槌被鐵鏈或繩索懸吊在廊車內部。廊車破城槌無需衝鋒來獲得最大動量。此外，在尾部加裝引繩可使能夠協助使用該破城槌的機師組成員額外增加4人。

  生命值（Hit Points）：破城槌硬度為5，生命值基於體型。大型、超大型、巨型和超巨型破城槌的生命值分別為30點、120點、320點和625點。

Huge Siege Tower.name: 超大型攻城塔（Huge Siege Tower）
Huge Siege Tower.description:
班組 12; 速度 15尺

  這是一臺具有堅固結構的木造廊車——攻城塔擁有高大的護頂部件。木塔的下部內含了推動該攻城塔的機師組成員，併為他們提供全掩蔽效果。破損狀態的攻城塔只能以半速移動。若攻城塔被破壞，整座木塔將崩毀。此種情況將視為坍塌來處理。攻城塔的上部為一定數量（見下文）的士兵提供強化掩蔽效果，並擁有可供遠程武器攻擊的射擊孔。塔頂部分可以加裝垛牆、並安置一臺體型不大於該攻城塔的攻城兵器，外加一副鐵鴉喙。攻城塔的基本速度為15尺（在安裝中甲或重甲時為10尺）。攻城塔硬度為5，生命值基於體型。大型、超大型、巨型和超巨型攻城塔的生命值分別為60點、240點、640點和1250點。

Incendiary Crossbow Bolt.name: Incendiary Crossbow Bolt（Incendiary Crossbow Bolt）
Incendiary Crossbow Bolt.description:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 19

Statistics

Cost 10 gp Weight 3 lbs.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

Description

A metal cage behind this arrow's point contains flammable material. You take a -1 penalty on attack rolls when firing incendiary arrows. You can light up to six incendiary arrows as a full-round action (a standard action if you use a tindertwig) that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Once lit, the arrow burns for 2 rounds. A lit incendiary arrow deals an additional 1 point of fire damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Reflex save or catch fire.

Incendiary bolts exist for crossbows.

Injection Spear.name: Injection Spear（Injection Spear）
Injection Spear.description:
Source Pathfinder #61: Shards of Sin pg. 64, Classic Horrors Revisited pg. 8

Statistics

Cost 60 gp Weight 8 lbs.

Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x3; Range -; Type P; Special -

Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Exotic

Description

This exotic two-handed weapon allows the user to inject targets with liquid on a hit. The spear's reservoir can hold up to 5 doses of a single fluid-a single dose is automatically injected when the spear hits a target. A non-proficient user can wield an injection spear as a standard spear but cannot trigger the injection. An injection spear is otherwise identical to a normal spear, save that it cannot be thrown, weighs 8 pounds, cannot be used to brace, and costs 60 gp.

Iron Brush.name: 判官筆（Iron brush）
Iron Brush.description: 這種看起來像是普通毛筆的武器筆身為鋼製，筆尾裝有尖釘。雖然並不是非常有威力的武器，但判官筆很容易藏匿（使用者在將判官筆藏在身上的巧手檢定+2），也可以將之拋擲出一段距離來打擊對手，或用來擊打對手身上秘孔要穴、造成難以預料的破壞。

Iron-Tipped Distance Arrows (20).name: Iron-Tipped Distance Arrows (20)（Iron-Tipped Distance Arrows (20)）
Iron-Tipped Distance Arrows (20).description:
Source Ultimate Combat pg. 130

Statistics

Cost 1 gp Weight 4 lbs.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

Description

Used tactically for long-range attacks on troops, these arrows are fitted with heavy iron heads. While these heads help them travel great distances, they make the arrows less effective at dealing damage.

Iron-tipped distance arrows increase their bow's range increment by 10 feet but take a -1 penalty on damage dealt per range increment (minimum 1 point of damage).

They are sold in leather quivers in quantities of 20.

Jutte.name: 十手（Jutte）
Jutte.description: 這種鐵尺似的武器裝有一個反轉的鐵鉤，可以用來格擋或鉗制住對方的兵器。部分十手還有特製的尖頭甚至開刃。

Kasatha Spinal Sword.name: Kasatha Spinal Sword（Kasatha Spinal Sword）
Kasatha Spinal Sword.description:
Source People of the Stars pg. 9

Statistics

Cost 50 gp Weight 3 lbs.

Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x3; Range -; Type P or S; Special fragile

Category Light; Proficiency Exotic

Description

This light one-handed sword is covered in bony spines that make it easier to poison opponents. The save DC of a nonmagical injury poison applied to a kasatha spinal sword increases by 2. Kasathas treat kasatha spinal swords as martial weapons.

Katana.name: 武士刀（Katana）
Katana.description: 這種刀劍通常是為武士設計的，由數種不同材質的鋼材以複雜的工藝摺疊鍛打而成。武士刀的刀身細長而鋒銳，微微彎曲的單面開刃可以讓劍士通過劈砍斬斷對手的脖頸和肢體。雖然武士刀有著完美的平衡，但是它並不容易熟練掌握。一個角色可以雙手使用武士刀作為軍用武器，但必須擁有“擅長異種武器（武士刀）”專長才能單手使用它。

Kerambit.name: 虎牙刺（Kerambit）
Kerambit.description: 這件纖小，彎曲的匕首在握把的底端有一個圓環，讓它可以套在手指上或是藏在頭髮內。雖然並不大，這把造型狠毒的小武器可以造成十分嚴重的傷害。虎牙刺非常易於隱藏（使用者在將虎牙刺藏在身上的巧手檢定+2），所以忍者和刺客愛用這種武器。

Kestros.name: 投鏢索（Kestros）
Kestros.description: 投鏢索是一種青銅時代的奇異投具，它用來發射專門的投鏢。你能在使用投鏢索時將力量修正加至傷害，如同它是投擲武器一般。你能單手使用投鏢索發射，但無法裝填。為投鏢索裝填是一個需要用到兩隻手、並且會引發藉機攻擊的移動動作。半身人能將投鏢索視為軍用武器。

Kestros Dart (10).name: 投鏢（Kestros Dart (10)）
Kestros Dart (10).description: 投鏢用投鏢索來投擲，它將9寸長的金屬尖端安裝在12寸長的木杆上、再加裝羽毛等物來協助飛行穩定性。一隻投鏢在作為近戰武器時屬於輕型臨時武器，它可以造成與同樣型號的匕首相同的傷害（重擊倍率×2）。10只投鏢一組放在一個皮袋裡。

Kusarigama.name: 鎖鐮（Kusarigama）
Kusarigama.description: 這把單鐮的手柄末端連接著一條10尺長度的細密鎖鏈，鎖鏈的另一頭還裝有一枚重錘。單鐮可以用來鉤掛、劈砍或擋格對手的攻擊，而鐵錘則可以依靠旋轉鎖鏈提供的離心力猛擊目標。

Kyoketsu Shoge.name: 距拔（Kyoketsu shoge）
Kyoketsu Shoge.description: 這件武器的主體是一把長約一尺的雙刃刀，其一側還延伸出一支形似鳥嘴的彎鉤旁枝。刀刃底部連著一條10尺長的繩索，繩索的另一端則是一枚大型的鋼環。在戰鬥中，這把刀可以如同匕首一樣作為副手近戰武器或是投擲武器。繩索和鋼環則可以用來揮舞攻擊，如同一件鈍擊長兵器。

Large Gallery.name: 大型廊車（Large Gallery）
Large Gallery.description:
班組 3; 速度 15尺

  廊車是形如革制或木造建築般的可移動防禦工事。多數廊車結構脆弱，但亦偶有較為堅固的實例（採用攻城兵器的裝甲規則，並調整其AC、硬度和生命值等資料）。廊車基本上由可移動的“牆壁”部分，加上作為“屋頂”的另一塊部件構成（內建破城槌的廊車是個例外，通常由兩塊接合的外壁部分和頂蓋部分構成）。由於廊車是局部開放結構，因此無法像正常的建築般提供掩護：若廊車內的生物體型與廊車相同則獲得掩蔽，小於廊車一級則獲得強化掩蔽，小於廊車兩級以上則視為全掩蔽。廊車的體型空間類似生物——一輛大型廊車能夠容納和保護的生物數量如同大型生物，等等。

  【譯註：即大型廊車能容納1個大型生物或4箇中型生物；可參考怪物通用規則的活吞能力。】

  裝有輪子的木造廊車可以在由完整機師組操作時以10尺的速度移動，或在機師組減半的情況下移動5尺。廊車的基本速度為15尺（在安裝中甲或重甲時為10尺）。廊車的硬度為5，生命值基於其體型。大型、超大型、巨型和超巨型廊車的生命值分別為30點、120點、320點和625點。

Large Ram.name: 大型破城槌（Large Ram）
Large Ram.description:
班組 5; 速度 15尺

  這種包有金屬頭箍的圓木當屬最基本的突擊型兵器，由一個或多個生物合力使用。破城槌可用於對目標造成傷害，或針對目標的破壞DC進行力量檢定。

  破城槌衝鋒（Ramming Charge）：破城槌的有效使用需要蓄積動量。使用破城槌的所有生物必須通過沖鋒動作來使其發揮最大效用。不願衝鋒的生物可以通過一個整輪動作來進行破城槌攻擊，攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定都受到-4減值。

  破壞 / 擊破（Breaking）：機師長進行一次有+2加值的力量檢定，協助攻擊的每位機師組成員都會額外給予+2加值（體型更大的生物則等效換算）。破城槌本身的體型每大於中型一級，會再給予該檢定+4加值。

  傷害（Damage）：機師長進行一次受-4不擅長減值的攻擊檢定，命中則造成列表中給出的傷害值，外加機師長和全體機師組成員的力量修正，體型不會影響該修正。

  臨時破城槌（Improvised Ram）：任何樹木、圓木或木料都可以當作破城槌使用，但攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定都受到-4減值。

  鎬頭（Pick）：擁有鎬頭的破城槌在對抗石造建築時，攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定獲得+2環境加值。

  鑽頭（Screw）：擁有鑽頭的破城槌在對抗土造建築時，攻擊檢定、傷害檢定和力量檢定獲得+2環境加值。

  廊車破城槌（Gallery Ram）：該破城槌被鐵鏈或繩索懸吊在廊車內部。廊車破城槌無需衝鋒來獲得最大動量。此外，在尾部加裝引繩可使能夠協助使用該破城槌的機師組成員額外增加4人。

  生命值（Hit Points）：破城槌硬度為5，生命值基於體型。大型、超大型、巨型和超巨型破城槌的生命值分別為30點、120點、320點和625點。

Large Siege Tower.name: 大型攻城塔（Large Siege Tower）
Large Siege Tower.description:
班組 6; 速度 15尺

  這是一臺具有堅固結構的木造廊車——攻城塔擁有高大的護頂部件。木塔的下部內含了推動該攻城塔的機師組成員，併為他們提供全掩蔽效果。破損狀態的攻城塔只能以半速移動。若攻城塔被破壞，整座木塔將崩毀。此種情況將視為坍塌來處理。攻城塔的上部為一定數量（見下文）的士兵提供強化掩蔽效果，並擁有可供遠程武器攻擊的射擊孔。塔頂部分可以加裝垛牆、並安置一臺體型不大於該攻城塔的攻城兵器，外加一副鐵鴉喙。攻城塔的基本速度為15尺（在安裝中甲或重甲時為10尺）。攻城塔硬度為5，生命值基於體型。大型、超大型、巨型和超巨型攻城塔的生命值分別為60點、240點、640點和1250點。

Launching Crossbow.name: Launching Crossbow（Launching Crossbow）
Launching Crossbow.description:
A launching crossbow is designed to launch splash weapons.

  Loading a launching crossbow is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Lawrence 1917 Flamethrower.name: 勞倫斯1917型火焰噴射器（Lawrence 1917 Flamethrower）
Lawrence 1917 Flamethrower.description:
啞火 -; 彈容量 6

  作為塹壕戰所衍生出的無數科技產物中最為臭名昭著者之一，在20世紀初恐怖的火焰噴射器仍然處於它的襁褓階段。英國陸軍所設計的勞倫斯1917型噴火器很快也被露西亞軍改採用，這件早期型的噴火器包括一對笨重的背攜燃料缸和一支手持箍管火焰噴嘴（被稱為“火槍”）。當火焰噴射器瞄準目標後，操作員扳動噴嘴部分的開關，燃油在噴射的同時被噴口出安置的煤氣噴槍點燃，形成熊熊燃燒的高熱液體火球。一整缸火焰噴射器燃料可以支持6次噴射，對目標造成毀滅性的破壞。

  使用火焰噴射器攻擊時，攻擊者可以 發射一道60尺長度的線型火焰，對攻擊線上的每個目標分別進行一次攻擊檢定，這些攻擊檢定都需要承受-2減值並無法應用需要精確攻擊以及額外增加傷害的專長（如暴擊Vital Strike）。給予目標掩蔽的效果，比如煙霧，法術模糊術，隱形術和鏡像術均不會影響自動火器的攻擊線。如果任一攻擊骰造成了重擊威脅，你必須單獨為其進行重擊確認投骰。

  所有被火焰噴射器攻擊到的生物都會承受4d6點火焰傷害，並且每一個接觸到火流的生物都需要通過一個DC20的反射檢定否則立刻著火，在每輪都受到1d6點火焰傷害直到火焰熄滅。著火的生物可以通過一個整輪動作重新進行反射檢定，如果在地上翻滾滅火的話可以在此反射檢定中獲得+2加值。

  火焰噴射器的燃料缸異常笨重，攜帶它的生物在防禦等級上會承受-4減值。除此之外，燃料缸的硬度為10且只有5點生命值，如果燃料缸被擊破且攜帶者的鄰接格內有任何明火（包括火焰噴射器自身），洩露的燃料缸會立刻引火自爆，處於火焰噴射器攜帶者半徑20尺範圍內的所有生物都會承受3d6點火焰傷害（通過DC20的反射檢定減半），同樣的，受到傷害的生物生物都需要通過一個DC20的反射檢定否則立刻著火。

Lawrence 1917 Flamethrower Fuel Tank.name: 勞倫斯1917型火焰噴射器燃料缸（Lawrence 1917 Flamethrower Fuel Tank）
Lawrence 1917 Flamethrower Fuel Tank.description: 這對燃料缸可以容納燃油或其他類型的噴射燃料。完全充滿的燃料缸可以支持火焰噴射器進行6次噴射。

Light Ballista.name: 輕型弩炮（Light Ballista）
Light Ballista.description:
班組 1; 瞄準 0; 裝填 2; 速度 10尺

  形如一把巨大的十字弓弩，弩車通過一對可調整的轉軸來為絞線積蓄彈力。轉軸之間的絞線被向後拉，即可在滑槽中裝填用以發射的彈藥。弩炮是一種直射型兵器。

  這種通用型的大型弩炮又稱勁弩或巨蠍，可以移動，也常被安裝於高塔或載具上。輕型弩炮硬度為5，生命值為50。輕型弩炮的弩矢每支重10磅，價格為10gp。

Light Bombard.name: 輕型臼炮（Light Bombard）
Light Bombard.description:
班組 2; 瞄準 1; 裝填 3; 速度 10尺

  形如一口大釜、或者其他傳統火炮，此類火器讓彈藥劃過高挑的弧線，給軍陣或城牆造成致命打擊。臼炮通常用於拋射，但也能作為直射型兵器射擊。當用於直射時，攻擊檢定承受-4減值、同時射程增量減半，但不再具有最小射程的限制。與所有火器類似，臼炮不會掉鏈但有其啞火率。

  輕型臼炮形似旋轉儀與大釜的結合體。由於後坐力強大，它們常被安裝在地面或是城牆的石壁上。輕型臼炮的彈道檢定DC為15，啞火範圍為1-2（炸膛半徑10尺）；硬度為10，生命值為70。輕型臼炮的每顆彈丸重25磅，價格為30gp。

Light Catapult.name: 輕型投石車（Light Catapult）
Light Catapult.description:
班組 2; 瞄準 2; 裝填 3; 速度 10尺

  投石車是通過旋轉鉸線把手來扭轉投臂蓄力、再將置於投臂末端杯槽內的重物拋射出去的投石型攻城兵器。投石車可以擊發一系列不同類型的彈藥（上表中給出的傷害值預設為投射石塊；其他投射物可在下文中找到）。它們屬於拋射型兵器。

  此類大型投石車通常裝有輪子。輕型投石車的彈道檢定DC為15；硬度為5，生命值為50。輕型投石車的每顆投石重50磅，價格為10gp。

Light Shield.name: 輕型盾牌（Light shield）
Light Shield.description: 除了防禦，你還能用輕型盾牌猛砸敵人。

Light Slaver's Crossbow.name: Light Slaver's Crossbow（Light Slaver's Crossbow）
Light Slaver's Crossbow.description:
Source Monster Codex pg. 45

Statistics

Cost 250 gp Weight 6 lbs.

Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical 19-20/see "bolas bolts" text; Range 40 ft.; Type B; Special nonlethal, trip, see text

Category Ranged; Proficiency Exotic

Description

This crossbow shoots ammunition called bolas bolts instead of crossbow bolts. It comes in both light and heavy varieties (but not double, hand, or repeating crossbow varieties) with the same reload action as a conventional crossbow of its type.

Light Trebuchet.name: 輕型拋石機（Light Trebuchet）
Light Trebuchet.description:
班組 3; 瞄準 2; 裝填 3; 速度 0尺

  拋石機與投石車相似，將重物置於長臂末端的籃筐內，再用配重（通常由人力或畜力拉緊繩索來代替）控制槓桿另一端。拋石機通過槓桿原理可拋出足以同時攻擊數個方格的大量物體，攻擊區域大小取決於拋石機自身體型。拋石機過於笨重，以至於無法以車輪或載具驅動，只能在戰場上進行組裝。拋石機的最小射程為150尺。

  該大型攻城兵器通常向目標拋射巨石（彈道檢定DC為15）。輕型拋石機的散射彈藥對目標方格造成完整傷害，並對該目標方格5尺範圍內所有生物和物體造成一半傷害（生物可以進行DC為15的反射豁免來將傷害減半）。輕型拋石機的硬度為5，生命值為50。輕型拋石機每次拋射所用的巨石重60磅，價格為15gp。

Liquid Ice (Siege).name: 寒冰彈（Liquid ice (Siege)）
Liquid Ice (Siege).description: 這隻瓷罐中裝滿了鍊金玄冰，可以作為投石車或拋石機的彈藥。它在命中後對目標方格5尺範圍內的每個生物造成4d6點寒冷傷害，每個生物必須進行DC為20的強韌豁免，失敗則會被糾纏1輪；在目標方格5尺到30尺之間範圍的每個生物和木製物品也必須進行DC為20的反射豁免以減半傷害，但豁免失敗亦不會被糾纏。若攻城兵器掉鏈，該彈藥會在投射前爆發，如同目標為此攻城兵器所佔據的某個方格般（具體由機師長決定）造成區域性傷害。

Little Starstones Sling Bullets (10).name: Little Starstones Sling Bullets (10)（Little Starstones Sling Bullets (10)）
Little Starstones Sling Bullets (10).description:
Source Halflings of Golarion pg. 22

Statistics

Cost 5 cp Weight 2 lbs.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

Description

Though they are technically sling ammunition, these thread- or cloth-wrapped pebbles are mainly used for signaling or celebration rather than battle, as they barely hit hard enough to sting. When soaked in oil or strong alcohol, they burn brightly for 1 round, illuminating an area like a candle and creating brief streaks of light as they fly through the air. They generally aren't hot enough and burn out too quickly to ignite combustibles.

Lizard King War Trident.name: Lizard King War Trident（Lizard King War Trident）
Lizard King War Trident.description:
Source Classic Monsters Revisited pg. 38

Statistics

Cost 20 gp Weight 12 lbs.

Damage see text (small), see text (medium); Critical x3; Range 10 ft.; Type P; Special brace

Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Martial

Description

Upon his 100th birthday, a lizard king's status is officially acknowledged, and he is honored with the presentation of a special weapon, the war trident, reserved exclusively for the use of his kind. These large, two-handed tridents are much heavier than normal (12 pounds) in order to take advantage of their wielders' great strength, and as a result they lose their range increment but deal 1d10 points of damage and have a x3 critical hit multiplier. In addition, extensive ritualistic practice with this weapon gives the lizard king the Improved Critical (war trident) feat as a bonus feat. A war trident is worth 20 gp, although most are masterwork and many are inlaid with precious metals and fetch higher prices.

Lungchuan Tamo.name: 杖隱刃（Lungchuan Tamo）
Lungchuan Tamo.description: 這支短棍形的劍鞘裡裝有一對纖細的短刀，它們的設計非常適合投擲。

M1914 Grenade (Concussion).name: M1914手榴彈，衝擊型（M1914 Grenade (Concussion)）
M1914 Grenade (Concussion).description: 這種延時點火的衝擊型手榴彈是塹壕戰的主力武器之一。手榴彈的基本構造一個金屬彈體和手柄的組合，內裝彈簧式擊針。如果要用它進行攻擊，使用者只需要打開保險裝置，按壓擊針，在投擲出去後手榴彈會在你的下一輪——通常是在你希望的區域內。自動點火起爆。這種制式的手榴彈依靠爆炸的衝擊波傷害周圍的目標，所有在爆點周圍20尺半徑範圍內的生物都會受到3d6點鈍擊傷害（通過DC15的反射檢定減半）。

M1914 Grenade (Fragmentation).name: M1914手榴彈，破片型（M1914 Grenade (Fragmentation)）
M1914 Grenade (Fragmentation).description: 加裝額外的預製破片套後，標準的衝擊型M1914手榴彈就可以獲得更為強大，但是爆炸半徑更小的破片傷害。這種手榴彈的使用方式與標準的手榴彈相同，不過它的影響半徑降低為15尺，造成4d6點鈍擊和揮砍傷害（通過DC15的反射檢定減半）。

M1917 Chemical Grenade.name: M1917毒氣手榴彈（M1917 Chemical Grenade）
M1917 Chemical Grenade.description: 這種彈體加大型的M1914手榴彈在起爆後會放射出毒氣雲。M1917毒氣手榴彈有一個相對過大的金屬筒狀彈身和一隻相對較為短小的手柄和底部保險機構，在投擲前，使用者需要拉開手榴彈的保險針再按壓擊針才能使其工作。在你的下一輪開始時，投擲出去的手榴彈會放出20尺半徑的芥子氣雲，毒雲會存在4輪時間，不過強風（21英里/小時）可以在1輪內將毒雲完全吹散。

Machete.name: Machete（Machete）
Machete.description:
This tool is a wide, single-edged blade about 2 feet in length. Most often used to hack through dense vegetation, it works equally well as a weapon.

  A character proficient with a machete gains a +1 circumstance bonus on Survival checks to get along in the wild.

Madsen Light Machine Gun.name: 麥德森輕機槍（Madsen Light Machine Gun）
Madsen Light Machine Gun.description:
啞火 1-2; 彈容量 20,30或40

  這挺強勁的自動武器足夠輕便，足以由單兵攜帶和操作。麥德森輕機槍使用的口徑為露西亞軍所使用的7.62x54mm步槍彈。麥德森輕機槍使用頂部彈匣裝彈，可以選擇20,30或40發裝彈匣。和大多數機槍相同，麥德森輕機槍只能自動射擊。

Madu (Leather/Steel).name: Madu (Leather/Steel)（Madu (Leather/Steel)）
Madu (Leather/Steel).description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 20, Legacy of Fire Player's Guide pg. 22, Adventurer's Armory pg. 4, Ultimate Combat pg. 144

Statistics

Cost 40 gp/50 gp Weight 5 lbs./6 lbs.

Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical x2; Range -; Type P; Special performance

Category Light; Proficiency Exotic

Weapon Groups Blades, Light; Close

Description

The madu is a round, light leather shield with two animal horns-usually from an antelope-extending from opposite sides. If you are proficient with the madu, you may use it to fight defensively with a -2 penalty instead of the normal -4, and your attack penalty for using Combat Expertise improves by +1 (minimum -1 penalty). You cannot hold anything else in the hand that bears a madu. If you are not proficient with the it, treat it as a light spiked shield. A madu can't be disarmed. It can be crafted entirely out of metal, but both versions offer the same basic protection and attack benefits, though they respond differently to some spells and effects. A druid can use a leather madu, but not a steel madu.

Manople.name: Manople（Manople）
Manople.description:
This rigid, fingerless gauntlet has three blades projecting from the gauntlet’s hand. The central blade is straight and double edged, while the side blades are curved like the prongs of a sai.

  You can’t use the hand on which a manople is worn for anything else. A manople takes a full-round action to don, and gives you a +10 bonus to your CMD against disarm attempts.

Manticore's Tail.name: Manticore's Tail（Manticore's Tail）
Manticore's Tail.description:
Source Belkzen, Hold of the Orc Hordes pg. 39

Statistics

Cost 1,000 gp Weight -

Damage 3d8; Critical 19-20/x2; Range see text; Type P

Crew 3; Aim 0; Load 4; Speed 0 ft.

Category Direct-Fire (Huge); Proficiency Siege Engine

Description

This massive ballista fires a dozen or more bolts at once in a devastating rain of steel that deals 3d8 points of damage. The crew leader makes a separate attack roll with a -2 penalty against each creature and object within a 60-foot cone, ignoring concealment. Confirm any critical threats separately. This weapon has a mishap only if the first attack roll is a mishap. A manticore's tail has a hardness of 5 and 100 hit points. Ammunition for one use of the manticore's tail costs 120 gp and weighs 120 pounds.

Mattock.name: 鶴嘴鋤（Mattock）
Mattock.description: 鶴嘴鋤是一把雙手長鎬，不過尖端為鑿狀而非尖刺。

Maxim M1910 Machine Gun.name: 馬克沁M1910重機槍（Maxim M1910 Machine Gun）
Maxim M1910 Machine Gun.description:
啞火 1-2; 彈容量 250

  這臺沉重的機槍使用250發7.62x54mm彈鏈供彈。雖然只需要一個射手就可以射擊，不過為了有效射擊通常還需要一個彈藥手負責為機槍供彈。以一個整輪動作，彈藥手可以通過一個特殊的協助他人動作為射手的下一次攻擊檢定提供+2加值。因為其沉重的結構，馬克沁重機槍通常需要裝在輪車底座並架設護盾用於塹壕防禦，或是搭載在被稱為“塔商卡”（Tachanka）的馬拉車上機動（見下文）。假設馬克沁重機槍的射手可以手提該武器而非架設在支架上射擊，他也會因為後坐力而在攻擊檢定上承受-4減值並被擊倒至俯臥。馬克沁重機槍只能進行全自動射擊，如果射手在射擊此武器時保持俯臥，那麼重機槍的護盾可以為他提供掩蔽效果。

Metal Cartridge.name: 金屬定裝彈（Metal Cartridge）
Metal Cartridge.description: 這些鍊金定裝彈的強化版提供給近代火器。它們可以裝配彈頭或霰彈。

Meteor Hammer.name: 流星錘（Meteor hammer）
Meteor Hammer.description: 這件武器由一對通過10尺長的鎖鏈連接的鐵錘組成。你可以旋舞鐵錘以利於鎖鏈捆綁對手。當你用流星錘進行一次摔絆戰技攻擊且命中時，你可以選擇將目標向你拉近5尺而非將其擊倒。除此之外，流星錘有兩種用法：攻擊模式和防禦模式。在攻擊模式下，你可以將其作為一件雙頭武器使用；而在防禦模式下，你只能使用它的一頭，但是在防禦等級上獲得+1盾牌加值。你可以在自己的行動輪開始時決定使用何種戰鬥模式。

Monk's Spade.name: 禪杖（Monk's Spade）
Monk's Spade.description: 禪杖是一件雙頭長兵器，一頭是斧狀的鏟刃、另一頭則是類似公牛雙角的月牙刃。根據使用者用禪杖的不同頭進行攻擊，這件武器可以造成多種不同類型的傷害：鏟刃可以造成鈍擊或揮砍傷害，月牙刃可以造成揮砍或穿刺傷害。

Mosin-Nagant M1891 Rifle.name: Mosin-Nagant M1891 Rifle（Mosin-Nagant M1891 Rifle）
Mosin-Nagant M1891 Rifle.description:
Source Pathfinder #71: Rasputin Must Die! pg. 64

Statistics

Cost 500 gp Weight 9 lbs.

Damage 1d10 (medium); Critical x4; Range 80 ft.; Type B and P; Special -

Misfire 1; Capacity 5

Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Exotic

Description

This bolt-action rifle is the mainstay of Russian military forces. It is similar to the advanced firearms rif le with the following differences. It uses the same 7.62 54mmR ammunition as the Madsen machine gun, and is fed from a 5-round internal, nondetachable magazine that is typically loaded with 5-round stripper clips (loading it is a move action).

Without stripper clips, you may only reload up to 2 rounds of ammunition as a move action. Ammunition is typically sold in groups of 5 rounds.

The rifle has a lug for the attachment of a socket bayonet, and can be equipped with a unique sidemount scope system (see below).

Musket.name: 滑膛槍（Musket）
Musket.description:
啞火 1-2 (5尺); 彈容量 1

  這種長管火器的射程比手槍遠很多。滑膛槍的彈藥為1顆彈頭加1份黑火藥，或1發鍊金定裝彈。這是一件早期火器。

Nagant M1895 Revolver.name: 納甘 M1895左輪手槍（Nagant M1895 Revolver）
Nagant M1895 Revolver.description:
啞火 1; 彈容量 7

  這把左輪手槍的資料與先進火器中的左輪手槍相同（參見極限戰鬥P139），不過它的裝彈量為7而非6。

Naginata.name: 薙刀（Naginata）
Naginata.description: 薙刀由一段6尺長的刀柄和長約2尺、類似劍刃但略彎的刀身組成，薙刀的長度可以讓使用者在不受到對方的刀劍、以及類似短兵器威脅的情況下從容地展開攻擊。

Nine-Ring Broadsword.name: 九環大刀（Nine-Ring Broadsword）
Nine-Ring Broadsword.description: 這種沉厚單刃砍刀在刀背上掛有數個金屬環，以額外的重量增強其劈砍的力道。

Nine-Section Whip.name: 九節鞭（Nine-section whip）
Nine-Section Whip.description: 這件武器的主體部分是九節互相連接的鐵條，而它的末端則是一支6吋長的銳利鋼刺。九節鞭可以單手或雙手，甚至雙持使用。

Nodachi.name: 野太刀（Nodachi）
Nodachi.description: 這把長刀有著長達4尺、銳利無比的刀身。步兵常利用它來對抗騎馬的敵人，既可以用來將騎手挑下馬背，也可以支在地面上對抗騎兵衝鋒。

Orc Skull Ram.name: Orc Skull Ram（Orc Skull Ram）
Orc Skull Ram.description:
This weapon consists of a wooden log with a shoulder strap to carry some of the weight. The name comes from the orc tradition of making the ram’s head out of a large skull.

  On a successful critical hit with a skull ram, you can attempt a combat maneuver check to bull rush your opponent as a free action.

Paddle-Foot Pistol.name: Paddle-Foot Pistol（Paddle-Foot Pistol）
Paddle-Foot Pistol.description:
Source People of the Wastes pg. 15

Statistics

Cost 2,500 gp Weight 5 lbs.

Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x3; Range 20 ft.; Type B and P; Special scatter

Misfire 1-2 (5 ft.); Capacity 4

Category One-Handed; Proficiency Exotic

Description

This early firearm has four barrels, each of which can be fired one at a time with a single adjustable flintlock. The paddle-foot pistol fires in a 20-foot cone when making a scattering shot, and it has a 20-foot range increment when firing a bullet.

Additionally, the paddle-foot pistol has a maximum range of three range increments. Each barrel of a paddle-foot pistol can hold 1 dose of black powder, along with either pellets or a bullet, or it can hold a single alchemical cartridge.

Pata.name: 拳劍（Pata）
Pata.description: 作為拳刃的進化版本，拳劍是固定在不分指鐵手套前面的短劍。你以此武器發動的攻擊相較戳刺更像是拳擊，這是你能夠在每一擊中蓄積更強的力道。你無法用持有拳劍的手抓握任何其他東西。拳劍在抵抗針對其本身的卸武戰技時令你的CMD+10。

Pellets (30 Handfuls).name: 霰彈(30包)（Pellets (30 Handfuls)）
Pellets (30 Handfuls).description: 一包霰彈通常與1份黑火藥配合，用作具有霰彈特性的單手火器或雙手火器的彈藥；儘管碎石或別的小塊硬物也能當霰彈來用。如果一件霰彈武器使用霰彈或鍊金定裝彈以外的物品來進行錐形攻擊，將使啞火值提高1（不過這種提升將在轉為使用標準彈藥時移除）。30包霰彈重1/2磅。

Pellets (Handful).name: 霰彈(1包)（Pellets (Handful)）
Pellets (Handful).description: 一包霰彈通常與1份黑火藥配合，用作具有霰彈特性的單手火器或雙手火器的彈藥；儘管碎石或別的小塊硬物也能當霰彈來用。如果一件霰彈武器使用霰彈或鍊金定裝彈以外的物品來進行錐形攻擊，將使啞火值提高1（不過這種提升將在轉為使用標準彈藥時移除）。30包霰彈重1/2磅。

Pepperbox.name: 胡椒罐手槍（Pepperbox）
Pepperbox.description:
啞火 1-2 (5尺); 彈容量 6

  這把奇特的槍有六個槍管，槍管可以在射擊間用手旋轉（自由動作，需要一支空閒的手），使它在6發子彈全射完以前不用填裝。胡椒罐手槍的每個槍管的彈藥為1顆彈頭加1份黑火藥，或1發鍊金定裝彈。這是一件早期火器。

Pepperbox Rifle.name: 胡椒罐步槍（Pepperbox Rifle）
Pepperbox Rifle.description:
啞火 1-2; 彈容量 4

  這把步槍的四隻槍管安裝在可旋轉的卡箍上，可以在兩次射擊之間迅速旋轉切換（一個自由動作）。胡椒罐步槍的彈藥為金屬定裝彈。這是一件近代火器。

Phaleros.name: Phaleros（Phaleros）
Phaleros.description:
Source Distant Shores pg. 12

Statistics

Cost 5 gp Weight 3 lbs.

Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x2; Range 20 ft.; Type P; Special -

Category Ranged; Proficiency Martial

Description

A phaleros is a type of metal javelin that stores a splash weapon in a small cage between the haft and the spearhead. When a phaleros strikes its target, the spearhead compresses toward the haft and breaks the payload, showering the target with its contents as though you had struck the target's square with the splash weapon. On a critical hit, you instead treat the target as though it had suffered a direct hit from the splash weapon. A phaleros is reusable, and reloading one with a splash weapon is a process that takes two rounds and provokes attacks of opportunity.

Pickaxe.name: Pickaxe（Pickaxe）
Pickaxe.description: A two-handed version of the heavy pick, the brutal pickaxe is equally effective at breaking up earth and stone as it is at sundering flesh and bone. Often a weapon of convenience for commoners, the pickaxe is also a favorite among brutes and thugs who value the intimidation factor afforded by the immense weapon.

Pistol.name: 手槍（Pistol）
Pistol.description:
啞火 1 (5尺); 彈容量 1

  手槍是最常見的火器之一，但是在大多數時候它也是個足以引起眾人的羨幕或好奇心的物品了。因此手槍的設計多姿多彩，從裝點奢華的噴火龍型到樸實簡約的木柄槍身，甚至單純只有金屬槍管和擊發結構。手槍的彈藥為1顆彈頭加1份黑火藥，或1發鍊金定裝彈。這是一件早期火器。

Pitted Bullet.name: 帶坑彈頭（Pitted Bullet）
Pitted Bullet.description: 這種彈藥上有小坑點，讓專門配方的毒藥填入。一份毒藥是通過鍊金處理成固體的標準毒素衍生物，可以通過一個DC額外+4的工藝（毒藥）檢定製造出所有標準的傷口或接觸型毒素的固體毒藥版本。購買一份已經準備好、用於帶坑彈頭的固體毒藥的花費相當於“基礎價格+20”gp。被製造出來後，毒藥可以被填入彈頭的小坑中並硬化。完成後，該彈頭可以被一件合適的火器發射，將毒素釋放到被它擊中的目標中，但毒素的豁免DC將-2。一顆帶坑彈頭不能用於鍊金定裝彈。

Plague Bundle (Siege).name: 腐疫彈（Plague bundle (Siege)）
Plague Bundle (Siege).description:
這隻堅硬的瓷罐內裝滿了高致病性的腐敗物，可以作為投石車或拋石機的彈藥。它僅能造成一半傷害，但每個被其擊中的生物將置身於造成腐熱症（filth fever）的穢物中。GM可以決定採用其他類型的疾病取代之。

  【疾病速查】腐熱症（filth fever）：類型－疾病，傷口感染；豁免－強韌DC12；潛伏期－1d3天；發作頻率－1次/天；效果－1d3敏捷傷害和1d3體質傷害；治癒－2次連續豁免。

Planson.name: Planson（Planson）
Planson.description: This 5-foot tapered pole is bound in metal with a narrow metal spike projecting from the top. The planson can be used as a club or as a sturdy, if top-heavy, spear to stop a charge.

Poisoned Sand Tube.name: 毒砂管（Poisoned sand tube）
Poisoned Sand Tube.description: 這支用金屬或竹節制造的，外形類似卷軸匣的吹管填滿了浸泡過吸入或接觸毒藥的細膩毒砂。當裝填滿三劑毒藥後，毒砂管的使用者可以通過大力吹動吹管，將毒砂揚到15尺錐形範圍內敵人的臉上。每一個處於影響範圍內的敵人都會受到一劑毒藥的影響。即使沙塵並未浸毒，被吹到的生物也必須通過一個DC12的強韌檢定否則將目眩1輪。每次使用之後毒砂管都必須重新裝入毒砂。裝填毒砂管是一個整輪動作，如果你擁有“快速裝填”專長，那麼裝填毒砂管是一個標準動作。

Powder Horn.name: 火藥筒（Powder Horn）
Powder Horn.description: 通常由動物的角製成，但由各種各樣形狀的金屬製成的火藥筒也越來越多。一個火藥筒可以儲存10份黑火藥。火藥筒可以保護儲存其中的黑火藥免受火、電、啞火的火器和水的影響。

Radium Pistol.name: Radium Pistol（Radium Pistol）
Radium Pistol.description:
Source Pathfinder: Worldscape #2 pg. 26

Statistics

Cost 4,500 gp Weight 3 lbs.

Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x4; Range 30 ft.; Type B and P; Special see text

Misfire 1; Capacity 6

Category One-Handed; Proficiency Exotic

Description

A radium pistol is a one-handed weapon with a revolving cylinder containing six chambers. Each chamberholdsaspecial radium-powder cartridge, and when one cartridge is fired, the cylinder automatically rotates (no extra hand or action required). readying the next cartridge for firing.

Radium Weapons

Barsoomian firearms are stocked with rare local woods. Metal components consist of an alloy of aluminum and steel that exceeds the strength of Earth metals (giving Barsoomian firearms a hardness of 12). Radium weapons fire special cartridges that must be manufactured under artificial light, as exposure to sunlight results in an explosion. When the cartridges strike their target they shatter exposingthe radium powder within. The moment sunlight strikes this substance it explodes with considerable violence, making the weapons versatile for either direct fire or suppressive fire. Radium weapons follow the general rules for advanced firearms found in Pathfinder Roleplaying Game: Ultimate Combat.

 

All radium weapons use radium cartridges for ammunition. As a result. in addition to targeting speci?c creatures or objects. the wielder may fire a radium weapon at an unoccupied square similar to throwing a splash weapon (Pathfinder RFC Core Rulebook 202). All creatures within 15 feet of the targeted square take 2d6 points of bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage (Reflex DC 15 half). Radium cartridge damage does not change based on the size of the weapon used to fire them. Radium cartridges cannot be ?red effectively in this way outside the rays of the sun, such as underground or at night. Radium cartridges cost 3 gp per cartridge.

Radium Rifle.name: Radium Rifle（Radium Rifle）
Radium Rifle.description:
Source Pathfinder: Worldscape #2 pg. 27

Statistics

Cost 5,500 gp Weight 10 lbs.

Damage 1d8 (small), 1d10 (medium); Critical x4; Range 100 ft.; Type B and P; Special see text

Misfire 1; Capacity 1

Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Exotic

Description
